subject: Nigeria could miss AFCON 2027 as striker woes continue
title: Nigeria's striker problem

lines.vo: Three-time African champions could miss the next Africa Cup of Nations.
lines.footage: Nigeria Super Eagles Chelle press conference

lines.vo: Nigeria drew nil-nil away in Tanzania. They have scored nothing in either away game this campaign. A lot of air miles for a zero.
Tanzania qualified as co-hosts, so one place is left for Nigeria, Guinea-Bissau and Madagascar. Musical chairs, with fewer chairs.
Guinea-Bissau beat Nigeria three-nil and lead the group. Nigeria have seven points from four games.
Coach Eric Chelle made seven changes. He played Arokodare and Awoniyi up front, without Lookman. Same problem. Maybe it is the ball.
They must win both March games, one by at least four goals. For a team with no away goals, that is bold.
The strikers have been asked to score. So far, no reply.
